_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. Read a staff card, a gift card and a member card: each shows a reading screen, with the camera as another way in. 2. Sign in on Android: the sign-in page should return to Vesopa Go by itself. 3. On a second device choose Connect with a code, then on a signed-in device open Settings, Connect a screen or TV and scan it. 4. Switch one device to Card terminal (Settings), then on another device choose Settings, Send card payments to a card terminal, and take a card sale. 5. On an Android TV: the app should open on a code, and the remote's arrows and OK should move and press. 6. Customer display, Settings, Adverts on this device: add pictures and a film from the device.
release_notes: A reading screen for staff, gift and member cards, with the camera too. Sign-in returns to the app on Android. Connect a screen or TV by scanning its code. A new Card terminal mode: one device takes card payments for another. Works with a TV remote. Adverts from the device's own files. Rename card readers. Bigger product photo preview.
